posts.title: Predator, prey, and vulture: And a horse
posts.description: (Originally posted via Substack) Since I was here last, I fell (spiraled) out of my posting routine. I’m struggling to get back up on the horse. So, this will be short. I live in Minnesota and can’t proceed without acknowledging the brutality and humanity that have collided here since December. But don’t look to me.
